第15章 要把律师也送进去（第1页）
此刻黄轩也意识到了问题的严重性，本来就是一起简单的校园霸凌，顶多就是故意伤害罪，对方顶多就是个轻伤。
就算是输了，也就只是个几年而已。
那...那自己跟之前林默有什么区別！
“审判长！我不服！我们是被冤枉的！”
他不能一出道就背上“律政鬼见愁”的称號啊。
“算了，黄律，冷静一点，不怪你，毕竟你还没进去。”
而这时，林默嘴角微微扬起，满是笑意的说道：
“谁知道你没有在背后煽动他们三个抢劫呢？毕竟你接受委託的时候，他们正好在抢劫，说不定就是你鼓动他们抢劫交的律师费。”
正在观看直播的各大律师瞬间汗毛竖起。
这个林默彻底疯了，他不会想要把律师也送进去吧？
而且好像...確实有这个可能性啊！
“你！你......你你血口喷人！只有你这种无良律师才会干这种事！”黄轩本来心態就不稳，听到这话彻底急了。
101看书101??????.??????全手打无错站
“审判长，对方律师誹谤我是无良律师，贬低我的人格，我觉得他的行为足以构成誹谤罪。”
有没有搞错，庭审都结束了啊，你还来参一本！
准备离席的王正华也是抿了抿嘴，无奈的看了一眼林默。
那表情好像在说：“你就放过他吧，他还只是个孩子。”

倒是黄轩听闻彻底崩溃了，捂著胀痛的心臟指著指著林默颤抖道：“你！你踏马不是人啊！怎么会有你这样不讲道理的律师！”
黄轩只觉一股怒气涌上心头，怒急攻心，心臟只觉得一阵绞痛。
然后林默看向审判长王者华，然后指著地上的黄轩，淡淡的说道：
“你看吧，审判长，黄轩律师过於急躁和那三罪犯沆瀣一气，所以我的怀疑是有依据的。”
“咳咳，行了行了，林律师，庭审已经结束了，有什么诉求你起诉就是。”
王正华知道自己再不说几句话，这林默能把黄轩气死，只能无奈的说道。
而且现在是直播现场，虽然林默的庭审很漂亮。
但不知道为什么，看著林默那微微扬起的嘴角，王正华心中升起了一股不一样的气息。
总感觉江海以后的法律界不会很太平。
想著，王正华摇了摇头，这个林默还在法律范围之內就行。
而这时候，观看直播的观眾们已经都快要笑疯了。
法庭上活生生把一方律师逼疯的画面，大家还是第一次见到。
就连观看直播的黄轩老爹黄坚成也是急的从位置上弹了起来。
哆嗦的指著屏幕：“这林默简直疯了！”
其他合伙人则是有些无奈且惊恐的说道：“黄律，这林默確实有点邪门，咱们还是別惹他了。”
全程都没有去证明你故意伤害，而是用另外一项更加重的罪来证明。
而且能想出入室抢劫这种顶级阴谋。
最后还趁火打劫，趁你愤怒至极的时候，给你精准的火上浇油。
没经歷过大场面的律师哪见过这场面。

Chapter 15: Send the lawyer in too (Page 1)
At this moment, Huang Xuan also realized the seriousness of the problem. It was originally a simple case of campus bullying. At most, it was intentional injury, and the other party was only slightly injured at most.
Even if he loses, it will only be a few years.
Then... what is the difference between me and Lin Mo before?
"Presiding Judge! I refuse to accept it! We were wrongly accused!"
He can't bear the title of "Law and Government are troubled by ghosts" as soon as he debuts.
"Forget it, Huang Lu, calm down, I don't blame you, after all, you haven't gone in yet."
At this time, Lin Mo raised the corners of his mouth slightly and said with a smile:
"Who knows that you didn't instigate the three of them to rob behind the scenes? After all, when you accepted the commission, they happened to be robbing. Maybe it was you who incited them to rob to pay the legal fees."
The hair on the hair of the major lawyers who were watching the live broadcast stood up instantly.
This Lin Mo is completely crazy. He doesn't want to send the lawyer in, right?
And it seems...it is indeed possible!
"You! You...you are slanderous! Only an unscrupulous lawyer like you would do such a thing!" Huang Xuan, who was already mentally unstable, became completely anxious when he heard these words.
101 Reading 101??????.?????? Make no mistakes with all your hands
"President, the other party's lawyer slandered me as an unscrupulous lawyer and demeaned my personality. I think his behavior is enough to constitute defamation."
Is there any mistake? The trial is over and you still want to participate!
Wang Zhenghua, who was about to leave the table, also pursed his lips and glanced at Lin Mo helplessly.
That expression seemed to say: "Just let him go, he's just a child."
Huang Xuan, on the other hand, completely collapsed after hearing this. He held his swollen and painful heart, pointed at Lin Mo and trembled: "You! You are not a human when you are riding a horse! How can there be such an unreasonable lawyer like you!"
Huang Xuan felt a surge of anger welling up in his heart, and his heart felt a twinge of pain.
Then Lin Mo looked at the presiding judge Wang Zhehua, then pointed at Huang Xuan on the ground, and said lightly:
"You see, presiding judge, Lawyer Huang Xuan is too impatient and colludes with the three criminals, so my suspicion is well-founded."
"Ahem, okay, okay, Lawyer Lin, the trial is over. If you have any demands, just sue."
Wang Zhenghua knew that if he didn't say a few words, Lin Mo would piss Huang Xuan to death, so he could only say helplessly.
And it's a live broadcast now, although Lin Mo's court hearing is very beautiful.
But for some reason, Wang Zhenghua felt a different aura in his heart when he saw Lin Mo's slightly raised corners of his mouth.
I always feel that Jiang Hai’s future legal world will not be peaceful.
Thinking about it, Wang Zhenghua shook his head, as long as Lin Mo was still within the scope of the law.
At this time, the audience watching the live broadcast was almost laughing crazy.
This is the first time that everyone has seen the scene of driving one lawyer crazy in court.
Even Huang Xuan's father, Huang Jiancheng, who was watching the live broadcast, jumped up from his position anxiously.
He pointed at the screen tremblingly: "This Lin Mo is absolutely crazy!"
The other partners said helplessly and horrified: "Huang Lu, this Lin Mo is indeed a bit evil, let's not mess with him."
Throughout the entire process, there was no attempt to prove that you intentionally caused harm, but another, more serious crime was used to prove it.
And he can come up with top-notch plots such as home invasion and robbery.
In the end, he took advantage of the fire and poured fuel on you accurately when you were extremely angry.
No lawyer who has never experienced a big scene has ever seen this scene.
